## Learning goals

By the end of this week, you should understand:

- the main opportunities and limitations of web data for research;
- how data validity, technical feasibility, legal risk, and research value can conflict;
- how to finalize and document a responsible web data project; and
- how to identify and address remaining questions before the exam.

## Closing lecture

The closing lecture brings together the main lessons from the course:

- why and when web data can strengthen research;
- how to select and understand a data source;
- design challenges involving extraction, looping, timing, infrastructure, and sampling;
- legal and privacy considerations; and
- limitations, opportunities, and responsible next steps.

The lecture also includes course evaluation, exam preparation, and remaining questions.

## Coaching

- Online coaching session (#4)
- Finalize the project data package and documentation.
- Complete the self- and peer-assessment requirements on Canvas.
